_comment: Errata for every published Nexoma book. To record a correction, add an entry to the matching volume's 'entries' array and bump 'last_reviewed'. Entries render newest-first in the order they appear here. 'printings' lists which printings/editions are affected.
policy: Every reported error is verified against the manuscript source before it is listed here.
Corrections are folded into the next printing and into the current EPUB and PDF as soon as they are confirmed.
Errors in the companion lab code are tracked as issues in the companion repository, not on this page.

_example_entry.correct: The text as it should read.
_example_entry.note: Optional explanation of why the correction matters.
